changes: Capture shared writing on input and keep it in a room-and-role scoped in-memory draft store.
Display persistent unconfirmed/awaiting/conflict information and the latest server-confirmed note separately.
Only the matching acknowledged event and submitted value clear a draft; typing after submission survives its earlier acknowledgement.
Keep old context drafts available on return and in a separate draft JSON, without displaying or automatically sending them in a new room/role/solo context.
Return the existing command event ID and surface correlated rejection events without changing server authorization, wire format or sequence/deduplication.
Common note inputs are disabled while startup or a new room has no confirmed state; confirmed-note exports and server autosaves retain their existing formats.

fixed: Awaiting confirmation was shown before releasing the held note.
Revision conflict kept A draft and displayed B confirmed record; warning remained in the notes section.
Draft JSON generated an actual download event.
A new room displayed its default confirmed question, without the old draft; global preservation/export notice remained.
Changing A to biology in the original room showed the confirmed B question and biology permissions; changing back to engineering restored A draft.
Manual resend made both tabs display A question and removed the warning.
Both researchers independently recorded their own interpretations; neither replaced the other.
A second limitation typed while the first awaited confirmation survived the first acknowledgement; manual resend applied it to both.
Closing both sockets displayed the connection lock; automatic reconnect restored both roles and all confirmed notes.
Biology ran N: 1 day x 2 repeats x 3 policies, 100 nodes/17 fixed regions; full result text matched both screens; current Incheon time remained 0.
Final built single HTML opened via HTTP with embedded modules; solo engineering note and +6h survived UI refresh, with no shared-draft warning.

finalConsole.scope: Bounded final error/warn queries, not an unbounded recording; baseline tabs were closed before collecting their logs.

preserved: Original HTML/legacy source and examples unchanged.
Incheon 4 facilities, 12 routes, 1394 road ways; nationwide 100 nodes/17 fixed study regions; virtual/estimated labels unchanged.
Simulation/biology/statistical engine files, equal researcher roles, four full pages, LIVE/TIMELAPSE/COMPUTE unchanged.
No main/merge/manual production deployment/domain/DNS/root service worker/Firebase/other PinCon routes/new hosting changed.
limitations: Drafts remain only in this page memory until acknowledged or exported; reloading discards unexported drafts. The new JSON is a manual review artifact and is not accepted as a world restore file.
Unsent/conflicting drafts are not silently retried or merged; researchers compare the latest confirmed text and explicitly resend.
Production health remains 404 and serverOrigin empty; static Pages is not a WebSocket host.
No actual Galaxy Tab, file://, airplane mode, actual site storage permission/disk exhaustion, long-duration tablet performance, or production-host persistence tests in this run.
No production 503 or real production note conflict was observed.
